body:
## Quick answer

**Bahe Kurtiz** stitches every outfit on this page in sizes up to **4XL**, and offers **free custom fit**: send your bust, waist, hip and height and we stitch the outfit to your body in our own unit in Jaipur. For weddings, flowing **Anarkalis** in georgette or chiffon and straight **kurta sets** with a long dupatta are the most flattering, comfortable choices.

## What flatters a plus size figure

| Goal | Choose | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Long, lean line | Floor-length Anarkali or a straight long kurta | One unbroken line from shoulder to hem |
| Comfort for a long day | Cotton or cotton-blend kurta set | Breathable, easy to sit in |
| Evening glamour | Georgette or chiffon Anarkali | Drapes softly instead of adding bulk |
| Defined shape | Empire or high waist seam | Skims the midsection, draws the eye up |

Heavy, stiff fabrics can add volume; flowing georgette, chiffon and soft cotton drape better. Velvet looks rich in winter – choose a simple cut with less embellishment.

## Getting the size right

Indian sizes are labelled by bust measurement and differ between brands, so compare your measurements in inches rather than the letter. Use our [size converter](/tools/indian-size-converter/) or choose custom fit – it costs nothing extra.

## Shipping, fit and returns

- **Free express shipping** to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE and Australia, with tracking – duties and taxes included, nothing to pay on delivery
- Ready sizes ship in 2–4 working days; custom fit pieces in 5–7 working days, then 5–10 business days for delivery abroad (3–5 days within India)
- **Free custom fit** – send your bust, waist, hip and height and we stitch the outfit to your measurements
- Sizes XS to 4XL, made in our own unit in Sanganer, Jaipur

faq.q: Do you make plus size Indian outfits?
faq.a: Yes. The styles on this page come in sizes up to 4XL, and any style can be stitched to your measurements free of charge.

faq.q: Which Anarkali is best for plus size women?
faq.a: A floor-length Anarkali in a flowing fabric such as georgette or chiffon, with an empire or high waist and balanced detailing, is usually the most flattering.

faq.q: Is there an extra charge for custom fit or bigger sizes?
faq.a: No. Custom fit is free, and bigger sizes cost the same as smaller ones.

faq.q: What if the size does not fit?
faq.a: If we stitched it wrong to your measurements we remake it free; if your measurements were off we offer one free alteration. Ready-size pieces can be exchanged within 7 days of delivery.
No. We ship duties-paid (DDP) to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE and Australia – shipping is free and there is nothing extra to pay on delivery.
